comparison.objective: Play a two-hand musical passage with specified notes, timing, holds, and dynamics.
comparison.physical_skill: Independent finger timing, velocity control, sustained bass notes, and coordinated key release.
comparison.success_condition: Correct ordered MIDI events, synchronized bass, dynamic separation, steady tempo, all keys released and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Keyboard performance tests temporal bimanual dexterity and force modulation, not industrial many-body separation or receptacle recovery.
